items.headline: Indian Markets Eye Cautious Opening Amid Global Uncertainties
items.summary: Indian stock markets are expected to open with a cautious, potentially negative bias, influenced by elevated crude oil prices and ongoing geopolitical tensions involving US-Iran negotiations and concerns over the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: US Markets Close Lower, Asian Markets Show Mixed Trends
items.summary: Overnight, US markets concluded Monday with slight losses, while Asian markets are displaying mixed to slightly positive movements, with some regions observing public holidays.

items.headline: FIIs Remain Net Buyers in Indian Equities
items.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) continued their buying spree, injecting ₹480.24 crore into Indian equities on Friday, August 7.

items.headline: RBI to Conduct ₹125,000 Crore VRRR Auction to Absorb Liquidity
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is scheduled to conduct a 3-day Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction today, August 11, 2026, aimed at managing surplus liquidity in the banking system.

items.headline: RBI Maintains Repo Rate at 5.25%, Neutral Stance Amid Global Headwinds
items.summary: Following its Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting on August 5, 2026, the RBI decided to keep the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, reaffirming a neutral policy stance in light of global uncertainties and persistent inflationary pressures.

items.headline: India's CPI Inflation Surpasses RBI Target at 4.38% in June
items.summary: India's Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation rose to 4.38% in June 2026, exceeding the RBI's 4% target for the first time in 17 months, mainly due to higher transportation and food prices.

items.headline: RBI Revises FY27 Inflation Forecast Slightly Downward to 5.0%
items.summary: The RBI has slightly revised its FY27 inflation forecast from 5.1% to 5.0%, indicating a moderate outlook for core inflation, despite recent spikes in headline figures.

items.headline: GST Collections Hit Record High of ₹2.11 Lakh Crore in July
items.summary: Gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections reached an unprecedented ₹2.11 lakh crore in July 2026, marking a robust 15.4% year-on-year growth.

items.headline: Key Companies to Announce Q1 FY27 Results Today
items.summary: The market is in the final phase of the Q1 FY27 earnings season, with Siemens, Zydus Lifesciences, MRF, Rail Vikas Nigam, PI Industries, Manappuram Finance, NBCC (India), and Bata India among companies scheduled to release their results today.

items.headline: Vodafone Idea Narrows Losses in Q1 FY27, Revenue Grows 6%
items.summary: Vodafone Idea reported narrowed consolidated losses to ₹3,754 crore for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 6% year-on-year.

items.headline: Electronics Mart India Reports Q1 FY27 Results In Line with Expectations
items.summary: Electronics Mart India announced Q1 FY27 results that met analyst expectations, posting revenues of ₹24 billion and statutory earnings per share (EPS) of ₹2.78.

items.headline: Hindalco's Net Profit Surges 75% Year-on-Year in Q1 FY27
items.summary: Hindalco Industries reported a significant 75% surge in net profit year-on-year for Q1 FY27, although the company maintains a cautious outlook on bauxite auctions due to potential input cost pressures.

items.headline: Titan Reports Strong Q1 FY27 Performance Driven by Jewellery Sales
items.summary: Titan Company delivered a robust Q1 FY27, with net profit jumping 62.9% and revenue climbing 29.3%, primarily propelled by strong jewellery segment sales.

items.headline: Windlas Biotech Schedules Q1 FY27 Earnings Call, Estimates Shared
items.summary: Windlas Biotech has scheduled its Q1 FY27 earnings call for today, August 11, with market estimates projecting revenues between ₹234-₹269 crore and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹15-₹19 crore.

items.headline: Mildly Bullish Undertone in Market on Strong Q1 Results
items.summary: Despite broader cautious market sentiment, a 'mildly bullish' undertone prevails, largely attributed to better-than-expected Q1 earnings results from various companies.

items.headline: IT and Auto Sectors Lead Market Gains in 2026, Nifty Auto Hits All-Time High
items.summary: The IT and Auto sectors have emerged as strong performers in 2026, with the Nifty Auto index recently achieving an all-time high, showcasing sector-specific strength.

items.headline: Consumer Sector Anticipates Stronger Demand, Faces Input Cost Challenges
items.summary: The consumer sector expects stronger demand, with FMCG growth projected at 9-11% for August-November. However, the sector grapples with elevated input costs like palm oil, crude, and packaging, alongside rising competition from quick-commerce.

items.headline: BSE Ltd to Replace Wipro in Nifty50 Index
items.summary: BSE Ltd is set to replace Wipro in the benchmark Nifty50 index, a change effective from September 30, 2026, following the semi-annual review by NSE Indices.

items.headline: Several Companies Go Ex-Dividend Today, August 11
items.summary: Castrol India (Interim Dividend - ₹6.25 per share), Dhunseri Ventures (Dividend - ₹1.50 per share), Ratnamani Metals & Tubes (Dividend - ₹10 per share), and Tainwala Chemical and Plastic (I) Limited (Interim Dividend - ₹3 per share) are trading ex-dividend today.

items.headline: Key Stocks to Watch Today, August 11, 2026
items.summary: Stocks expected to be in focus today include M&M, Vodafone Idea, BEL, Wipro, BSE, Lupin, IRB Infra, Gland Pharma, KEC International, Zen Technologies, JSW Energy, PC Jeweller, Lloyds Metals and Energy, Bosch, Brookfield India REIT, ITC, Jupiter Wagons, and JSW Steel.

items.headline: Titan, Infosys, Tech Mahindra Among Top Gainers; SBI, Reliance Lag
items.summary: On Monday, August 10, Titan, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, and HCL Technologies were notable top gainers, while State Bank of India and Reliance Industries were among the laggards in the Sensex pack.
